result_summary: ALL TESTS PASSED with 759 passing assertions and 0 failures, re-run on the committed tree at app commit 363ea67. The new testKeyboardShortcutMappingActionTargets covers action titles, resolution of 向左切换桌面/向右切换桌面 to the system Control-Left and Control-Right shortcuts, resolvedShortcut and displayText, decoding of a legacy target stored as a bare RecordedShortcut with no kind discriminator, coexistence of legacy and new-format rules, action-target encode/decode round trip, rejection of a source equal to the selected action's own trigger, acceptance of remapping Control-Left to an unrelated target, engine claim and one-shot emission of the resolved shortcut, automatic-repeat suppression without re-emission, pass-through of marked synthesized events, service-level claim and suppression with delivery through the existing poster, and retention of the action target when accessibility is denied. The pre-existing store, engine, service lifecycle and mapping-priority tests still pass unchanged.
limitations: The command-line test target does not exercise the NSAlert accessory layout, the NSSegmentedControl tab switching, or the radio button group.
System-delivered keyboard events and TCC behavior are represented by controlled test doubles.
